Criteria.TestCondition: If NO flashing content is found, then this Test Condition DOES NOT APPLY (DNA). If flashing content IS found, then this test should be recorded as NOT TESTED.
Criteria.TesterComment: The Trusted Tester process records flashing content as Not Tested. According to our experimental flash analysis, this flashing does not fail WCAG 2.3.1. A video (analyzed at full screen): 6.5 flashes per second, 6,112 square pixels flashing at once (the limit is 21,824 in any 341 by 256 pixel area), light and dark flashing. We analyzed the first 10 s of 18.0833 s. Because flashing was found, the page cannot meet the non-interference test (1.D).
